increment_paragraph: **OPENSSL-PEM-CALLBACK-ARM (2026-11-18).** A literal-argument premise may stand beside synchronous invocations that are a declaration's only retaining clauses (contract spec C04.5 "Beside a synchronous invocation", C04.19 placement, grammar G05, new gateway rule 57); every other retaining clause beside a premise still rejects. Route G's premise rewrite (legacy_literal_premise) now treats a withheld retaining declaration as a contracted callee, so an unmet premise renames the call before the callback route reads it; with that change reverted the fixture's non-null-x call was measured Safe. On the user's decision of 2026-11-18, resource_callback_invoked_or_default(F, A...) (schema Invoked { null_default }, omitted when false) is the same invocation except that a null pointer constant at F invokes nothing; every other actual is decided by rule 13u as before, no body check establishes it (rule 13y withdraws it in a defining unit), and rule 15w never forwards through it. pem.qv: both PEM readers drop the cb = 0 premise and state resource_callback_invoked_or_default(cb, _, _, _, u); the x = 0 premise stays (the reuse arm still refuses). The OpenSSL checker derives and requires the new clause set; contracts.lock re-pinned (the two pem digests only). Lean QCore.CallbackLiteralPremise (31 audited theorems). Measured (merged with main 016ce2639, r26 and r27): the opt-in current run over the OpenSSL callers' seven files moves no row and changes 3 rows' content: rdkafka_ssl.c:761, 833 now refuse callback-uncontracted (rd_kafka_transport_ssl_passwd_cb), rdkafka_cert.c:349, 405 the member store of the result; the null-cb reads (Monkey tls_load_builtin_credentials, the predecessor fixture's read_cert, Pending) keep their in-premise reading, which a first measurement without the null default had lost. Pinned routes cannot move by construction (no pinned contract states a premise beside an invocation or the new spelling, and none reads the user load path); the declared arbiter is the integrator's.

ledger.why: DISCHARGED by OPENSSL-PEM-CALLBACK-ARM (2026-11-18): the loader admits a literal-argument premise beside synchronous invocations only (C04.5, C04.19, G05, rule 57), route G's premise rewrite reaches withheld retaining declarations (measured necessary: without it the reuse arm was Safe), and, on the user's decision of 2026-11-18, resource_callback_invoked_or_default states a null callback that invokes nothing (only a null pointer constant; no body check establishes it, rule 15w never forwards through it); QCore.CallbackLiteralPremise audited (31 theorems); pem.qv states resource_callback_invoked_or_default(cb, _, _, _, u) beside the x premise, checker shape and lock follow. The null-cb reads keep their in-premise reading (Monkey tls_load_builtin_credentials, the predecessor fixture's read_cert Pending); the null-default follow-up the first measurement exposed (OPENSSL-PEM-NULL-CALLBACK-DEFAULT, never registered on main) is discharged within this card. Of the seven librdkafka calls only rdkafka_ssl.c:790 (&ca at x, the reuse arm) stays outside the premise; the remaining blockers are callback-uncontracted (rdkafka_ssl.c:761, 833), member stores of the result (rdkafka_cert.c:349, 405) and calls in loop or branch conditions (rdkafka_cert.c:272, rdkafka_ssl.c:790, 1292).

ledger.title: librdkafka's PEM password callbacks as contracted candidates
ledger.text: Registered by OPENSSL-PEM-CALLBACK-ARM (opt-in current run at 046accf6). rd_kafka_ssl_PKEY_from_string and rd_kafka_ssl_X509_from_string (rdkafka_ssl.c:761, 833) refuse callback-uncontracted: rd_kafka_transport_ssl_passwd_cb has no validated summary (it calls rd_kafka_dbg and rd_kafka_log). rd_kafka_conf_ssl_passwd_cb (rdkafka_cert.c:51) is reached at rdkafka_cert.c:349, 405 only behind the member store cert->x509 / cert->pkey of the returned reference (indirect memory access is outside the resource projection); rdkafka_cert.c:272 and rdkafka_ssl.c:1292 call the reader in a while condition and rdkafka_ssl.c:790 in an if condition (unmodeled call in a condition). DISCHARGE: an identity contract in force for rd_kafka_transport_ssl_passwd_cb (its logging contracted or a declared summary), and the member-store and condition-call readings, measured on the opt-in run.
